core.title: 36 Inch Contemporary Rectangular Door Pull, First Impressions 3478/36

text.description_html:
First Impressions 3478/36 36" Long Contemporary Rectangular Door Pull

This unique design door handle can be used in many different applications such as:

  • Appliances, such as Refrigerators and Freezers
  • Entrance, Patio or Store Front Doors
  • Furniture and Cabinet Doors

Also available: Shorter 20 Inch Contemporary Rectangular Door Pull

Specifications for First Impressions 3478/36-US28 Door Pull

  • Overall Length: 36"
  • Mounting Centers (distance between the 2 mounting holes): 32" C/C
  • Pull Thickness: 1"
  • Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Material: Aluminum
  • Finish: Brushed Aluminum

Note: This door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door). Optional Surface mounting or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other - Requires 2 door pulls).

*Sold individually.
